name: On Call
source:
On Call is a visual novel that takes you through a 3-day rotation at Merritt General Hospital. Build trust with your patients and their families to get them on the road to recovery. Manage your own stress while confronting these challenges or you may just crack under the pressure.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2547180/]Steam[/url]]
